name: get_services_list
description: Lists every ClickHouse and Managed Postgres service in an organization. Each entry has serviceType ("clickhouse" or "postgres"), id, name, provider, region, state, and createdAt; ClickHouse services add version, endpoints, replica and memory settings, idle scaling, IP access list, private endpoints, and encryption fields, while Postgres services add version, VM size, storage size, and HA type. Use the id values with the service-scoped tools. If one service kind cannot be listed, result holds the other kind and partialResults and warning explain what is missing; if both fail, result is an error object.

organizationId.description: Organization whose services to list. Use the id of an organization returned by get_organizations.
